Indexing Cookbook

Indexes let the planner avoid scanning every row. The recipes below show the most common shapes and when each one pays off in practice.

Single column

CREATE INDEX idx_orders_customer ON orders (customer_id);
ANALYZE orders;

Composite

Put the equality column first, then the range column, so one index serves both predicates.

CREATE INDEX idx_orders_cust_date ON orders (customer_id, created_at);

Partial

CREATE INDEX idx_open_orders ON orders (id) WHERE status = 'open';
